scope: Experimental forward-only single-object token-budgeted spatial memory in the isolated Lean worktree; one condition frame, FP32 CPU and indexed RoPE.
candidate: Fixed 16,384 represented spatial feature tokens, with 3,072 reserved for up to three author insurance entries. Keep full condition memory and newest full entry; eagerly apply the author's already-selected pending compression before admission; evict oldest whole spatial entries to fit, preserving their object pointers and saved prediction outputs. Both storage admission and memory reads use the resident token entries. Disable the author's EMA old-tail replacement and resident-pruning behavior so the window's retained history is actually read; this is an explicit change to the model. For ages beyond the six learned noncondition temporal slots, reuse the oldest learned noncondition slot. No new confidence gate, detector, redetection, threshold, labels or learned weights.
validation: Two independent isolated-checkout no-op seq3 replays must exactly match the original indexed reference masks, selections, positions, events and parameter identity. Two independent candidate seq3 replays must match one another, fit the represented spatial-token budget after every verified read and admission, respect the fixed insurance reserve, retain feature-position alignment and pointer outputs, and record actual admissions and evictions. No selected-sequence candidate runs until these checks and the unit tests pass.
limitations: Budget covers represented feature tokens plus insurance only, not unique bytes, positional tensors, pointers, masks, scores, anchors, temporary allocations or total RAM. Conservatively reserving bank capacity can underfill. Age clamping reuses a learned embedding and does not create a new learned long-range representation. The user-specified no-inset preprocessing must be used on both seq23 experiment arms.
